program.name: The Pretzel
program.subject: Sex positions
program.blurb: Hip-opening flows so you can get into the knotted positions and stay there, then strength at those angles.
program.about: For the pretzel and the other knotted holds, which ask your hips to open and stay. One day is a long hip-opening flow: pigeon, frog, lizard and happy baby, held long. The next builds strength at those same angles: Cossack squats, Copenhagen planks, side-lying adductions and frog pumps, so the range is yours to fuck in, not just to reach. Level II makes every hold longer and Level III adds reps.
